name: tinto-rooming-lists
description: Producing a per-tour rooming list — which guests are booked into which room, at which property — as a spreadsheet to send to a hotel or use internally. A standalone plugin, open to anyone on the team who needs it. Rebuilt 2026-09-15 against live production schema and real bookings: guest names now pull from linked Participants records rather than the Reservation's own name field, and room numbers are extracted from the existing 'Room N.' convention in Notes.
